cases.rationale: An actual black-and-white cow stands behind a white-and-tan resting dog. Passenger vehicles are visible on both sides, including the rear of a white vehicle with a spare tire on the right. The spoked wheels and wooden cart at left do not expose enough propulsion/frame detail to resolve whether a pedal-cycle component is present, so bicycle (1) remains unclear. The barrier, cart and vegetation do not identify any other defined category.

Actual people stand on the tennis court holding identifiable strung tennis rackets with handles. Clothing, hats, shoes, fencing and the ground supply no additional category objects. No unresolved category ambiguity.

The crop contains a washbasin and faucet, multiple toiletry bottles on shelves and near the faucet, and a cropped toilet seat/bowl at lower left. The large vessel on the left is a bathtub, not a bowl or sink. A tiny blue-tipped upright item and its partly obscured holder beside the faucet are insufficiently resolved to confirm a toothbrush (79) or drinking cup (41); both remain unclear. The mirror is not a display.

Two people occupy an identifiable long slatted bench. The seated person holds a cell phone, and a large backpack with zippered compartments and straps is clear in front, with an orange-capped drink bottle in its side pocket. The loose ground debris and greenery identify no additional defined objects; the backpack is distinguishable from a handbag or suitcase. No unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual tennis player and spectators are visible, with the player's strung racket at upper right. Individual stadium chairs and the courtside seated person's chair are identifiable; they are not a shared bench. Advertising text and indistinct crowd details do not establish additional category objects. No unresolved category ambiguity.

A man holds an actual woolly sheep whose body and head fill the foreground; other sheep are visible beyond the rail. The animals' fleece and heads support sheep rather than goats or other listed ungulates. The tree is unpotted and the metal rails are fencing. No unresolved category ambiguity.

The lower panel shows actual scissors with paired blades and two teal handle loops. The upper objects are a stone and crumpled lined paper; the paper is not a bound book and the scissors are not a single knife. Plain supporting surfaces do not establish a dining table. No unresolved category ambiguity.

An electronic multimeter sits before an illuminated enclosure containing a shallow rectangular tray and binder clips. The meter is not a remote, phone or time-of-day clock, and the enclosure does not identify a conventional cooking oven, microwave or standalone display. The tray is not an identifiable bowl, and the work surface lacks dining-table context. No unresolved category ambiguity among the defined objects.

A person's head, arms and hands are visible beside multiple actual computers. Rear and right hinged computers identify laptops and their keyboards, while the tall central separate monitor counts as TV under the definition. The foreground tablet and attached keyboard add keyboard evidence but the tablet itself is excluded from laptop. A dark small object partly obscured around the lower hand does not resolve a computer mouse (64), which remains unclear. This is a computer work desk, not an eating table; screen contents are excluded.

Actual people ride a pedal bicycle between parked passenger cars. A black rolling suitcase with an extended handle is cropped at lower right. The black soft bag hanging near the bicycle's front lacks enough exposed strap/body detail to distinguish backpack (24) from handbag/tote (26), so both remain unclear. Greenery has no identifiable pot, and the street scene supplies no other defined object.

The produce includes identifiable green apples, pebbled orange citrus at the bottom right, and a curved yellow banana segment along the right edge. The central white head is cauliflower, not broccoli; the bright orange lobed vegetable is a pepper, not a carrot. Partly hidden elongated tan/orange roots at left do not resolve carrot identity (51). A narrow curved container edge at left does not establish a bowl rather than another container (45). These two categories remain unclear; the leafy vegetables and celery do not add another listed category.

A child sits in a single-person chair at an eating table. A yellow-lidded drinking cup stands on a stack of cylindrical snack containers, which are not bottles. A hamburger with a bun and filling is on the flat plate at lower right. The background stainless appliance has refrigerator doors and handles; ordinary drawers and obscured kitchen background do not identify other appliances. The plate is not a bowl. No unresolved category ambiguity.
